contribution.label: Contribution
contribution.notes: One ERDA contribution publishes one or more digital objects as a single citable, versioned unit.

version.label: Version
version.notes: 1 for the original contribution, empty if the contribution is not activated, written during contribution activation

timestamp.label: Activation Timestamp
timestamp.description: Date and time of contribution activation
timestamp.notes: ISO 8601 date and time (e.g. "yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss.sssZ"), written during contribution activation

is_validated.label: Is Validated
is_validated.description: Contribution has passed the ERDA Data Model validation

is_reviewed.label: Is Reviewed
is_reviewed.description: Contribution has been reviewed for correct usage of the ERDA Data Model

reference.label: Contribution Reference
reference.description: DOI or citation of the publication this contribution supports
reference.notes: ERDA archives unpublished material, so a reference is recommended rather than required; the per-object `citations` column carries the source of an individual object.

author.label: Contribution Author
author.description: EarthRef handle, ORCID, or name and email of the author of the contribution

description.label: Description
description.description: Description of the contribution as a whole

supplemental_links.label: Supplemental Links
supplemental_links.description: Links to supplemental material hosted elsewhere

objects.label: Digital Objects
objects.description: An archived digital data object: the ERDA record a persistent link resolves to
objects.notes: One row per object. The files that make up the object are listed in the `files` table and reference this row by `object`.

row_id.label: Row ID
row_id.description: Unique row number within the table

object.label: Object Name
object.description: Name for the digital object, unique within the contribution
object.notes: Used by rows in the `files` table to reference their object

title.label: Title
title.description: Title of the digital object as it is displayed and cited
examples: Composition database of garnet peridotite xenoliths

alternate_titles.label: Alternate Titles
alternate_titles.description: Colon-delimited list of alternate titles the object is also known by

data_types.label: Data Types
data_types.description: Colon-delimited list of the kinds of digital object this is

expert_level.label: Expert Level
expert_level.description: Audience the object is pitched at

description.label: Description
description.description: Free-text description of the object and its contents

instructions.label: Instructions
instructions.description: How to open, run, or interpret the object

parameters.label: Parameters
parameters.description: Colon-delimited list of the measured or derived parameters the object reports

materials.label: Materials
materials.description: Colon-delimited list of the materials the object describes

samples.label: Samples
samples.description: Colon-delimited list of sample names the object reports on

education_topics.label: Education Topics
education_topics.description: Colon-delimited list of ERESE Resource Matrix topics this object teaches

computer_program.label: Computer Program
computer_program.description: Program needed to open or run the object

computer_program_version.label: Computer Program Version
computer_program_version.description: Version of the computer program the object was created with or requires

citations.label: Citations
citations.description: Colon-delimited list of DOIs or citations for the source of this object
citations.notes: Empty for the unpublished material ERDA exists to archive

source_url.label: Source Web Site
source_url.description: Web site the object was sourced from

project.label: Project
project.description: Project, workshop, or research theme the object belongs to
examples: Vailulu'u: the Active Samoan Hotspot Volcano

external_url.label: External Link
external_url.description: Location of the object when it is hosted elsewhere
external_url.notes: Required in practice for the "web link" data type, which archives a link rather than a file

doi.label: DOI
doi.description: DOI minted for this object, if it has one of its own

license.label: License
license.description: License the object is distributed under

copyright_owner.label: Copyright Owner
copyright_owner.description: Holder of the copyright on the object

copyright_description.label: Copyright Description
copyright_description.description: Copyright terms, permissions granted, and attribution requirements

copyright_url.label: Copyright Web Site
copyright_url.description: Web site stating the copyright terms

continents_oceans.label: Continents and Oceans
continents_oceans.description: Colon-delimited list of continents and oceans the object covers

countries.label: Countries
countries.description: Colon-delimited list of countries the object covers

state_provinces.label: States or Provinces
state_provinces.description: Colon-delimited list of states or provinces the object covers

regions.label: Regions
regions.description: Colon-delimited list of regions the object covers

oceans_seas.label: Oceans and Seas
oceans_seas.description: Colon-delimited list of oceans and seas the object covers

locations.label: Locations
locations.description: Colon-delimited list of free-text place names

lat.label: Latitude
lat.notes: Decimal degrees north; the center of the area for an object covering one

lon.label: Longitude
lon.notes: Decimal degrees east, -180 to 180 as in the legacy ERDA search (MagIC's 0-360 convention does not apply here)

lat_s.label: Southern Latitude
lat_s.description: Southern bound of the area the object covers

lat_n.label: Northern Latitude
lat_n.description: Northern bound of the area the object covers

lon_w.label: Western Longitude
lon_w.description: Western bound of the area the object covers

lon_e.label: Eastern Longitude
lon_e.description: Eastern bound of the area the object covers

age_high.label: Oldest Age
age_high.description: Oldest age of the material the object describes

age_low.label: Youngest Age
age_low.description: Youngest age of the material the object describes

age_unit.label: Age Unit
age_unit.description: Unit the ages are given in

files.label: Files
files.description: The files that make up a digital object
files.notes: One row per archived file. A single-file object has one row; a bundle (a zipped folder, an image series) has one row per file.

row_id.label: Row ID
row_id.description: Unique row number within the table

file.label: File Name
file.description: Name of the file as it is stored and downloaded

object.label: Object Name
object.description: Name of the digital object this file belongs to

title.label: Title
title.description: Short title for this file within the object

description.label: Description
description.description: What this file contains and how it relates to the rest of the object

format.label: Format
format.description: File format, normally the file name extension

media_type.label: Media Type
media_type.description: IANA media type of the file

checksum.label: Checksum
checksum.description: Algorithm-prefixed checksum of the stored file

timestamp.label: File Timestamp
timestamp.description: Date and time the file was created
